_curatorNotes: Elemental Absorption: burst can absorb one of Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro (once per use), adding elemental DMG ticks alongside the anemo ticks (every ~113 frames). Not modeled. Reviewer should decide how to represent absorption DMG in the effects row.
gcsim has a TODO comment: 'does sucrose burst snapshot?' — snapshotting behavior is unverified in source; snapshots field left unset for reviewer
abilities.description:
Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Wind Spirit comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro energy, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

passives.name: Catalyst Conversion
_curatorNotes: Effect target is 'self' but the description says all party members whose element matches the swirled element (excluding Sucrose). EffectTarget has no element-filtered team type. Reviewer must decide how to model or caveat this — possibly target: 'teamExcludingSelf' with a caveat noting the element-filter limitation.

2026-05-14 (Shape A reaction-key migration): trigger updated from broad `'swirl'` to OR-array [pyroSwirl, hydroSwirl, cryoSwirl, electroSwirl]. The +50 EM applies to any swirl Sucrose triggers; in-game it routes only to the matching element's teammates, which the existing target:'self' authoring (caveated above) under-renders.
passives.description: When Sucrose triggers a Swirl reaction, all characters in the party with the matching element (excluding Sucrose) have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50 for 8s.

passives.name: Mollis Favonius
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim a4() fires when E or Q hits an opponent — the onHit trigger captures the E case; the Q case is also a valid trigger source but the schema's onHit.abilityType is single-valued. Splitting into a second onHit ability:burst entry would dedup against the first (same stat); accepted as schema limitation.

Scaling buff: value field should be { type: 'scaling', stat: 'em', ratio: 0.2 } per recipe but kept as placeholder value:20 — needs reviewer pass when the renderer supports scaling buffs in onHit-triggered effects. Note: onHit-triggered team buffs don't currently render in the team-buff row regardless.
passives.description: When Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 or Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.

constellations.name: Chaotic Entropy
constellations.caveat: The +20% Elemental DMG Bonus fires when Sucrose's burst absorbs Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro on a given cast. The planner doesn't simulate which element absorbs, so the buff is authored as a generic +20% allDmgBonus on a manual-trigger window — toggle it on when applicable. In-game the buff applies only to the absorbed element (e.g. pyroDmgBonus), so the rendered value is an upper bound across teammates whose damage doesn't match the absorbed element.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-14, onAbsorption category): manual trigger preserved because absorbed-element state is null-resolving in the planner. The duration is intentionally left absent — the canonical burst-window-bound visualization is implicit; reviewer toggling the buff during a Sucrose Q window is the supported pattern. gcsim source: c6Absorb on every absorption tick, 6s base / 8s at C2+ (would need duration:6 + a durationModifier for C2 if ever upgraded to a deterministic trigger).
constellations.description: If Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II triggers an Elemental Absorption, all party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding absorbed element during its duration.
